findings.description: sendto and recvfrom return values are not checked.
Sending raw integers over the network can cause issues between systems with different endianness.
recvfrom is called with NULL for address and length, so the source is not validated.
If an error occurs in the loop, the program will continue running, possibly in a bad state.
